answer_1.quote: We introduce CLUST-MCMS, a novel two-stage pipeline for event-centric news clustering (ENC) followed by news cluster summarization, designed for real-world scenarios.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate MCMS using three metrics: • ROUGE: We report standard F1-based ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L scores... • Event Coverage (Eve-Cov)... • Entity Faithfulness (Ent-Faith)...

answer_3.quote: Prior work has demonstrated the effectiveness of protocol-guided prompting with GPT4 for generating silver-standard MCMS summaries, achieving high agreements of 0.96, 0.98, and 0.93 for redundancy, omission, and conflict.

answer_4.quote: We manually annotated the key events of each article cluster for event-level coverage and entity-level faithfulness evaluation.
